description:
Installation/packaging: the checked-in transpiled artifacts (cl/pcl-pack.lisp, cl/pcl-mro.lisp) embed build-machine absolute paths in their preambles (*pcl-pl2cl-path*, @INC pushes, perlbrew dirs) — regenerate on the target at install time, or make the preamble RELOCATABLE first (user note s335). Live evidence the paths are hostile to measurement too: s372's worktree compare reported EVERY file changed on ROOT alone. PROMOTED s375c to the v0.1 release track: this is the keystone under #277 (the installer, which per USER ruling also COMPILES the runtime + saved core at install, XS-model). Preference: make the preamble relocatable (derive from FindBin/runtime lookup) so the artifacts stay checked in and byte-comparable; the installer then only needs to VERIFY, not regenerate.

RE-SCOPED s401 (Fable, docs/fable-answers-s400.md Â§9): the artifacts embed
the build machine's paths BECAUSE they carry a PROGRAM preamble an extension
never needed â and that preamble RESETS @INC when the artifact loads (task
#349, silent wrong).  Resolution: `pl2cl --extension` omits the preamble;
the artifacts become machine-independent; #277 item 2 (regenerate at
install) is deleted.  This task CLOSES with #349.  User-file emission keeps
its preamble (per-machine output, correct).


CLOSED s404 by #349 (commit d1ecafc): the artifacts carried a PROGRAM
preamble they never needed, which is where the build machine's absolute paths
came from.  `pl2cl --extension` emits none; all three artifacts now contain
zero absolute paths and Pl/t/no-hardcoded-paths-01.t scans them like any
hand-written file instead of excluding them.  #277's item 2 (regenerate at
install) is deleted.
subject: Installation/packaging: checked-in transpiled artifacts embed build-machine absolute paths — regenerate (or relocate) at install time
